limitations: The installed 2.2-8 grouping code has no signposts or per-invocation timing/count events.
Time Profiler samples cannot yield exact call counts or per-round latency.
Core Animation commits are rendering submissions, not grouping refresh counts.
A16 does not support Processor Trace.
CPU/frame capture may be possible without replacing installed software; actual recording is required to verify.
